title: Understanding Mean Cubed Error
text: The Mean Cubed Error is calculated by taking the average of the cubes of the differences between the actual and predicted values. Think about how cubing a number affects its magnitude, especially when the number is negative.

title: Impact of Overpredictions and Underpredictions
text: Consider how the cube of a positive number compares to the cube of a negative number of the same magnitude. Which one grows larger? This might help you understand how overpredictions and underpredictions are penalized differently.

title: Comparing Cubes of Positive and Negative Numbers
text: If you have two numbers, $$2$$ and $$-2$$, which one has a larger cube?

title: Analyzing the Loss Function
text: When you cube a negative number, the result is negative, and when you cube a positive number, the result is positive. How does this affect the overall loss when you have overpredictions versus underpredictions?
